items.title: John Pizzarelli, Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I was on a bandstand with Bob Haggart and Ralph Sutton

ctx.x: Well it’s so funny. As stubborn as a mule and it just drove me up the wall. But the thing that I’m appreciative of is the fact that you watch kids, you watch these kids today. And they get that damn Real Book out and they open the Real Book up and they say okay “Body and Soul” page 6, and they’re all sitting there with music stands and it makes me want to puke. That’s the best word I can use. It’s like get rid of the damn book. You should have these songs in your head. And that was — at least the best thing is…
